description: NaCaYCdF₈ is Fluorite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4m2 space group. Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.44 Å. Ca is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. All Ca-F bond lengths are 2.38 Å. Y is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. All Y-F bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Cd is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent F atoms. All Cd-F bond lengths are 2.38 Å. F is bonded to one Na, one Ca, one Y, and one Cd atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNaCaYCd tetrahedra.
